name: Asian-Style Turkey Burger with Creamy Water Chestnut & Broccoli Slaw

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 ½ green bell peppers
1 ½ limes

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a large bowl.

Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl with the ginger and garlic along with turkey, bread crumbs, soy sauce, and spices; mix with your hands until well combined. Form the turkey mixture into 6 equal-sized patties and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg ground turkey
¾ cup panko bread crumbs
3 tbsp soy sauce
1 ½ tsp coriander, ground
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add burger patties and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties and cook an additional 5-7 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, place mayo and chili-garlic sauce in a small bowl. Stir to combine the spicy mayo and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice limes into a clean large bowl. Add additional mayo, sesame seeds, honey, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
1 tbsp sesame seeds
1 ½ tsp honey
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain and roughly chop water chestnuts. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with broccoli slaw, and stir to combine. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
170 g water chestnuts
1 ½ (340 g) pkgs broccoli slaw

instructions.primary_message: Spread spicy mayo over the bottom half of each bun; top with burger patties and a small handful of slaw. Close with the top half of each bun. Serve with remaining slaw on the side and enjoy!
